data.user_prompt: What are examples of websites built with Sanity CMS?

sections.text:
Sanity CMS is a flexible, headless content management system used by various organizations to build dynamic and scalable websites. Here are some notable examples:


[This Month in Ladybird - August 2024 - Ladybird](https://ladybird.org/newsletter/2024-08-31/?utm_source=openai)
**Figma**  
A collaborative interface design tool that utilizes Sanity CMS for its content management, enabling seamless collaboration among design teams.



[Microsoft подпомага новинарска емисия задвижвана от изкуствен интелект](https://avmedianow.com/a/microsoft-podpomaga-novinarska-emisiya-zadvizhvana-ot-izkustven-intelekt?utm_source=openai)
**Semafor**  
A global news organization that leverages Sanity CMS to manage and deliver its content efficiently across multiple platforms.



[8 Best Returns Management Platforms For Electronics Retailers In 2026](https://www.zigzag.global/blogs/8-best-returns-management-platforms-for-electronics-retailers?utm_source=openai)
**Loop Returns**  
A company specializing in e-commerce returns management, using Sanity CMS to provide a smooth user experience for online shoppers.



[F5 Networks Acquires NGINX, a Web Server Company, Bridging Developers and Network Operations Teams - GIGAZINE](https://gigazine.net/gsc_news/en/20190312-f5-acquires-nginx/?utm_source=openai)
**F5 Networks**  
A multinational company that builds application services and application delivery networking, employing Sanity CMS for its website content management.



[How Fashion Nova Has Built Huge Fashion Empire on Media Presence](https://envzone.com/fashion-nova-its-huge-bet-on-instagram-to-foster-a-ultra-fast-fashion-brand/?utm_source=openai)
**Fashion Nova**  
A popular fashion retailer that utilizes Sanity CMS to manage its extensive product catalog and content.


These examples demonstrate the versatility and scalability of Sanity CMS across different industries and use cases.
